verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Postgres Row Level Security as granular authorization rules that run inside the database, with a concrete per-user policy example keyed on auth.uid(). RLS also governs publishable-key access and Storage file permissions, Advisors flag misconfigured policies, and community users report RLS is fast to develop with once learned. Missing for 10: the pack only shows a SELECT policy example, so per-user INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies are not illustrated.

support.subject: As a developer, I can restrict data access per user with row-level security policies or security rules

citations.quote: Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) gives you granular authorization rules that run inside the database.
